_comment: Style packs for Qwen-Image-2512 (Q8_0) kids' art. 'signature' is pasted verbatim into every prompt in the pack so a whole set looks like one artist made it. 'negative' is a starter negative-prompt list for this medium - it only does anything on the 'full' runtime tier (real CFG); on 'lightning' it is correctly left unused, since CFG is forced to 1.0 there. Edit signatures/negatives/palettes for a WHOLE set at once, never per image. This file replaced the FLUX.2 [klein] 4B version of itself; runtime.variant values changed from base/distilled to full/lightning to match Qwen-Image-2512's two speed tiers.

2-4.label: toddler
2-4.detail_phrase: very simple shapes, large friendly features, generous empty space

5-7.label: early reader
5-7.detail_phrase: simple clear shapes with a few playful details

8-10.label: older child
8-10.detail_phrase: clear shapes with richer decorative detail

early-reader-6-8.label: early reader 6-8
early-reader-6-8.detail_phrase: simple clear shapes with a few playful details

middle-grade-9-12.label: middle grade 9-12
middle-grade-9-12.detail_phrase: clear shapes with richer decorative detail

teen-13-17.label: teen 13-17
teen-13-17.detail_phrase: confident composition with strong negative space and finer detail

adult-general.label: adult
adult-general.detail_phrase: restrained composition with a single clear focal idea and fine detail

coloring_page.description: Black-and-white line art for a child to colour in. No shading, no grey, no fill.
coloring_page.signature: clean black-and-white coloring book line art, {line_weight}, every shape fully closed, flat pure white background, large open areas left blank ready for colouring, printable children's coloring page
coloring_page.light: even flat lighting, every shape evenly lit
coloring_page.composition: single centred subject, whole subject inside the frame, wide white margin around the edges
coloring_page.background: plain white background with a few simple ground shapes

runtime.notes: Line art is where the 4-step distilled model fails most (broken or doubled lines). Draft on distilled if you want, but render the keeper on base.

coloring_page.negative: shading, grey, gradient, texture, photorealistic, colour, watermark, signature, extra limbs, blurry, broken lines, open outlines

chunky_vector.description: Bold flat vector shapes, board-book / preschool app look. Very forgiving, best default for toddlers.
chunky_vector.signature: bold flat vector illustration, thick even outlines, simple geometric shapes, flat solid fills of single colours, modern children's board book style
chunky_vector.light: flat even lighting, shapes evenly lit
chunky_vector.composition: centred subject, full body in frame, plenty of clear space around it
chunky_vector.background: simple flat colour background with two or three large simple shapes

runtime.notes: Flat shapes survive 4-step sampling well. Cheapest pack to iterate on.

chunky_vector.negative: gradient, photorealistic, photo, bokeh, bevel, drop shadow, watermark, signature, extra limbs, blurry, muddy colours

storybook_gouache.description: Soft painted picture-book illustration. Warm, classic, reads as 'real book art'.
storybook_gouache.signature: soft gouache picture book illustration, visible brush texture, warm muted palette, rounded friendly character design, classic children's storybook art
storybook_gouache.light: warm afternoon light, gentle soft shadows
storybook_gouache.composition: subject in the near foreground, simple depth with a soft background
storybook_gouache.background: softly painted background with loose simple shapes

runtime.notes: Brush texture needs the extra steps. Distilled drafts look plasticky.

storybook_gouache.negative: photorealistic, photo, 3d render, watermark, signature, extra limbs, blurry, harsh lighting, muddy colours

soft_watercolor.description: Gentle watercolor with paper grain. Good for bedtime, animals, nature.
soft_watercolor.signature: gentle watercolor illustration on textured paper, soft blended washes, delicate ink linework, airy pastel palette, calm nursery art style
soft_watercolor.composition: subject centred with generous white paper space around it
soft_watercolor.background: pale wash background fading into white paper

runtime.notes: Washes go muddy at 4 steps. Base only for keepers.

soft_watercolor.negative: photorealistic, photo, neon, high contrast, watermark, signature, extra limbs, blurry, harsh outlines

cut_paper_collage.description: Layered paper craft look. Very distinctive, hides small-model anatomy errors well.
cut_paper_collage.signature: cut paper collage illustration, layered construction paper shapes with visible torn edges, subtle drop shadows between layers, bright craft palette, handmade children's craft style
cut_paper_collage.light: soft overhead light casting small shadows between paper layers
cut_paper_collage.composition: flat front-on view, subject centred and fully visible
cut_paper_collage.background: solid coloured paper background with two or three simple cut shapes

runtime.notes: Hard-edged shapes hold up at 4 steps.

cut_paper_collage.negative: photorealistic, photo, smooth 3d, glossy render, watermark, signature, extra limbs, blurry

friendly_3d.description: Rounded toy-like 3D render. Use sparingly; the most expensive pack to get right.
friendly_3d.signature: cute stylised 3d render, soft rounded toy-like forms, smooth matte surfaces, big expressive eyes, bright cheerful lighting, modern animated short film look
friendly_3d.light: soft three-point studio lighting with gentle rim light
friendly_3d.composition: three-quarter view, full body in frame, shallow simple background

runtime.notes: Needs the base model; distilled 3d looks melted around hands and ears.

friendly_3d.negative: photorealistic human, uncanny, watermark, signature, extra limbs, blurry, melted hands, distorted face

_audience_note: The four hyphenated keys mirror the audience values used by the publish-book framework, so --age accepts either an age range or an audience value.

magic_suffix._comment: Qwen-Image's own reference pipeline appends one of these fixed phrases for photographic/cinematic output. It is NOT applied to any pack below - all of them are flat/illustrative, and the suffix fights that. Available via build_prompt.py --magic-suffix if you add a photoreal pack.
